name: ssh-config-manager
description: SSH manager for VS Code: organize your ssh_config in a side bar with groups, icons, colors, tags, notes and favorites, stored as comments inside the config file itself. Connect in a terminal or via Remote-SSH.

viewsWelcome.contents:
No hosts found in your SSH config.
[Add Host](command:sshManager.addHost)
[Open Config File](command:sshManager.openConfig)

sshManager.configFile.description: Path of the SSH config file to manage. Every other setting lives inside that file as a '#@ssh-manager' comment.

sshManager.backup.keep.markdownDescription: How many backups to keep. A backup is saved in the `ssh-config-backups` folder next to the config file before every change.

enumDescriptions: Copy both ways between the config and the shared file.
The config is a link to the shared file.
sshManager.sync.mode.markdownDescription: How this computer shares its SSH config with your other computers. Set it up with **SSH Manager: Set Up Sync Between Computers…** rather than by hand.

sshManager.sync.file.description: The shared config file in a synced folder (Dropbox, iCloud Drive, OneDrive, …). SSH keys are never synced.

enumDescriptions: Up when something answers on the host's SSH port. No login is made.
Up when the host answers a ping. Many cloud servers block ping.
sshManager.health.check.markdownDescription: How to tell whether a server is up, shown as a dot next to each host. A host can have its own choice: right-click it → **Set Status Check…**. Hosts behind a jump host are not checked.

sshManager.health.interval.markdownDescription: Seconds between status checks while the Hosts panel is visible. `0` checks only when you press **Refresh**.

sshManager.health.animation.description: Animate the status dot: a soft pulse while a server is up, a slow blink while it is down.

commands.title: Check SSH Keys on This Computer

walkthroughs.title: Get Started with SSH Config Manager
walkthroughs.description: Organize your SSH hosts in folders, tidy the Remote-SSH list, and keep the config backed up and in sync.

steps.title: Take the one-minute setup
steps.description:
The setup wizard walks through everything below, one screen at a time. You can run it again whenever you like.
[Open the Setup Wizard](command:sshManager.wizard)

media.altText: A terminal window connected to a stack of servers

steps.title: Organize hosts in folders
steps.description:
Make a folder for each project or customer, with subfolders inside for things like Production and Staging. Drag hosts between them.
[New Folder](command:sshManager.addGroup)

media.altText: A folder holding two subfolders of servers

steps.title: Tidy the Remote-SSH list
steps.description:
VS Code’s own “Connect to Host” list can show the same folders, with headings and a gap between them.
[Format the Remote-SSH List](command:sshManager.remoteSpacing)

media.altText: A list of hosts arranged in groups

steps.title: Backups you can restore
steps.description:
A copy of the config is saved in a folder next to it before every change.
[Back Up Now](command:sshManager.backupNow)
[Restore from a Backup](command:sshManager.restoreBackup)

media.altText: A stack of saved copies with a restore arrow

steps.title: The same hosts on every computer
steps.description:
Share the config through a file in Dropbox, iCloud Drive or OneDrive. Your SSH keys are never synced: copy them to each computer yourself.
[Set Up Sync](command:sshManager.syncSetup)

media.altText: A laptop and a desktop sharing a file through the cloud

steps.title: Check your SSH keys
steps.description:
See which hosts use a key that is not on this computer, and set up a new one in a single step.
[Check SSH Keys](command:sshManager.checkKeys)

media.altText: A key next to a locked server

steps.title: Work from the keyboard
steps.description:
Enter connects, F2 edits, and there is a shortcut for most actions in the panel.
[Show the Shortcuts](command:sshManager.shortcuts)

media.altText: A keyboard with three keys highlighted

steps.title: Make it yours
steps.description:
Every option on one page, with a live preview of the Remote-SSH list.
[Open Settings](command:sshManager.settingsPage)

media.altText: A panel of sliders and switches
